Likely narrowing of the DKK 1.2-1.4bn EBIT range. Direction unknown, with a slight lean toward the lower half on the Q3 fuel spike and soft volumes
Q3 adjusted FCF negative as guided (ETS payments, prepayment reversal); a change to the ~DKK 500m FY FCF guide is possible, direction unknown

Possible strategy review or financial-ambition headline, or a date for its presentation, from the new CEO and new chair; October volumes released the same morning at around 07:30 CET; direction unknown

findings.finding: Brent rose from about $71/bbl on 1 Jul 2026 to about $100 by 21 Sep (up more than 65% year to date, diesel at highs). DFDS said in Q2 that oil volatility 'increased the lag impact in the freight pass-through model', so Q3 likely carries a bunker-surcharge lag cost, only partly offset by the larger hedged share of the bunker spread.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Fuel-lag costs were named in the Q2 2026 Ferry review, and the stock still rose 13.2% on that print (guidance raised). The August 2025 Mediterranean warning moved it -18.4%. No clean reaction to fuel alone.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a macro-to-company transmission the company has not quantified for Q3: no profit warning came, and the low end was raised on 13 Aug. If the market priced it fully, the 11% fall from the 21 Sep high (172.7 to 153.9) would be accompanied by guide-cut chatter or estimate cuts; none was found. Partly priced through that drawdown.
findings.independence: Company's own statement on lag and hedging: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/a4f1120fe4a60f5ef247809eae708dcca (Q2 report p.4). Counter-evidence: Tallink Q3 EBITDA held near flat (EUR 67.9m vs 68.9m) through the same fuel environment, https://www.bairdmaritime.com/passenger/ro-pax/tallink-third-quarter-profit-rises

findings.finding: Q3 ferry volumes were soft: freight -3.2%/0.0%/-0.3% and passengers -1.6%/-4.6%/-4.7% for Jul/Aug/Sep, with Channel below 2025 every month. Over the same quarter Eurotunnel's truck traffic rose 5% and it gained 260bp of Dover Strait freight share, so the Channel ferry pool lost share.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Monthly volume releases on 14 Aug, 11 Sep and 13 Oct moved the stock +13.2% (with Q2), -1.1% and -0.2%. The volume line has not driven the print reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely is priced: the company published all three months and Getlink's Q3 came out on 22 Oct. It is sized near zero and kept only because yield and passenger mix within these volumes are not yet public.

findings.finding: Signals that the strategy review is close to done and may be aired with the Q3 report: the CTO release of 4 Nov speaks of 'our updated strategy'; the largest shareholder, Lauritzen Fonden, replaced the chair on strategy grounds with Niels Smedegaard plus a Polaris partner; and the Q3 date was pushed to 11 Nov because of the board change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The chair change announced with Q2 (13 Aug, after the close) coincided with a +13.2% session; the CEO succession news of 6 Nov 2025 came alongside a guidance cut (-2.6%).
findings.why_not_priced: The company's own timetable says 'within six months' (by about Feb 2027), so the market's default is no strategy content on 11 Nov. If an ambition headline were expected tomorrow, the stock would not have drifted down 5.35% in the five sessions into the print. Sign is genuinely two-sided: ambitious targets on one side, a new CEO's reset or impairment on the other (the Q2 report notes NAV exceeds market cap and the impairment test was updated).
findings.independence: Board change requested by Lauritzen Fonden over future strategy: https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/dfds-dfds-to-convene-egm-to-elect-new-board-members-chair-stepping-down-20260813 ; date moved to 11 Nov after the board changes: https://briefglance.com/companies/dfds-a-s/pulses/75643

findings.finding: The Algeciras-Tangier Med route assets (one RoPax, permits, about 200 staff, and capacity share on a joint RoRo raised from 33% to 50%) were acquired for DKK 165m and closed on 8 Oct. Capex and FCF outlook unchanged; Ceuta dropped.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. It falls inside unchanged guidance and lands in Q4, so it is filed at zero for completeness.
